TEXT: Come closer! I won't bite! You here to buy or here to sell?
Welcome! Are you buying or selling?
What's up! Want to see my wares?
Selling your fish? Or do you want some sweet upgrades?
Come in! Warm yourself by the fire. Now... Are you buying or selling?
Well met, friend! Here to buy or off-load your goods?
Are you here to buy or... have you created an new profile for me to buy?
Selling your goods? Or do you want to peruse my wares?
I hope you are not forgetting to use that profile builder. Anyways, what can I help you with?

As I previously mentioned, you put in a data-fish into the terminal over there and choose the desired data to extract from it. | Remember, this destroys the fish, so pick carefully. | Then, with that data extracted, access the profile builder on the whiteboard. | There, you put together an profile by dragging and dropping the data onto one of the slots. | Try to place the correct data into the correct slot and also to combine data to reference the same person for maximum profit. | Then, build the profile and bring it to me to sell.
Don't keep me waiting.
Have it your way.
C'mon, quit wasting my time.
Come back if you change your mind.
Nevermind? You came up to me and started the conversation, what do you mean nevermi-
Keep your wits about ya. | Aah reckon somethin' is hidin' en the clouds.
See you around, Compadre.
Hey you! | This area is off-limits! | … | Wait one minute... | You’re that newcomer Old Man told us about…

Yeah. | The Old Man found Concrete Cove first and invites only those he trusts to join it. | He spoke highly of you and told us that you were allowed here. | I’d wager he wants to speak with you right away. | Go on, he’s by the ledge.
Go on. | He's waiting on you.

Ahoy there! | I see that you made it in one piece. | However, I notice that you’re lacking one piece of crucial fishin' equipment. | Your rod! | I’d check by with “Chops” to see if he has any old rods on hand.

Ah! I forgot you’re new here. | Chops is our local dealer when it comes to gear and sellin' our fish. | His shop is located in that doorway with the fire barrel inside it. | I recommend being quick and firm with your dealings with him as he ain’t the guy to become chummy with if you catch my drift. | Anyhow, go talk to him, can’t do any fishing without a fishing rod.
Still can’t see any fishin' rod in your hands. | Go talk to Chops to get that sorted out.

Well, well, well! A new face! | You can call me Chops. | I am the local dealer here supplying fine data-fishers, like you, with all of the gear they need. | I also buy data-fishes and profiles off you, once you have any. | Speaking of which, I see that you have no fishing rod on your person. | That is one of many problems I can solve, for the right price. | … | As you are new… I’d wager you don’t have much disposable income on ya, so I’ll sell you one of my cheaper offerings. | She might be quite beat-up, but she’ll do the job. | Have a look.
There we are. | I hope she is to your liking. | Now, I ain’t a data-fisher, so you’ll have to go back to the Old Man to learn how to actually fish. | See ya around.

Now that you have your hand on a fishin' rod, it’s time to get down to brass tacks on how to data-fish. | To start, you throw that sucker as far into the cloud as you can. | The further you throw, the better the data-fish you can fish up. | From there, you wait for a data-fish to get caught on yer hook. | Then, it’s you against the fish, with a precision-timed reel to start the tug of war… | You have to move yer fishin' rod against the movements of the data-fish. | Precision and tracking are key to tire out the data-fish, so pay attention to which direction you have to move the rod! | And if you have done everything correctly, then you’ll reel in a datafish! | Or a piece of junk… | Regardless, you then sell your data-fish to Chops for a profit or use them to build a profile. | I assume you don’t have your hands on a profile builder yet, so I’d just focus on selling the fish to chops for now. | Happy data-fishin' and a warm welcome to Concrete Cove.
Just toss the hook as far as you can into the Cloud and start fishin'.

Now look at that! | You got yourself a fish! | Nicely done. | Now, go over to Chops; he'll probably want to buy that fish off you. | Or just continue fishin' and sell data-fish in batches. | Just remember that Chops closes up shop 22:00, so conduct yer business with him before then. | Anyways, feel free to strike up a conversation with me if you're lookin' for more tips.
You really are putting in the work with that rod. | Good on ya. | However, it ain't the quanitity of data-fishes that matters... | It's the quality!

Mhm! | You see, the data on a data-fish by itself is worth something but put them together with relevant data, and then you multiplying it's worth. | But you might ask, how do you combine data? | Well, it's easy! Use my patented profile builder duh! | Since you have been doing the work, I'll fork one over at a reasonable price. | I promise it'll be worth every Cloudbuck you spend on it.

There we are! Installed and ready to be used. | ... | Right, you have no clue how to use that thing. | Ok so, let me give you a quick rundown. | Most data-fishes will contain sensitive information about someone. | The terminal on the profile builder allows you to extract any single piece of data from a data-fish. | However, the process destroys the fish, so pick carefully! | With that piece of information, you can access the whiteboard to build a profile. | You slot in one of those piece of data you extracted and boom, you are actively building a profile on someone. | However, there is an art to this that comes in two forms: | 1. Any specific data can be placed anywhere, but the right data in the right slot increases the value of the profile more. | 2. The more accurate the data is to eachother and to the person you are building a profile on, the more truthful and thus valuable the entire profile becomes. | Once you have filled out the profile to your liking, you print that profile onto a driver and sell that driver to me for a profit! | Now, go out there and create some profiles!
How's yer fishin' going, kid?
Watcha' need?
Aye?
Sorry kid, I ain't got anymore tips for ya. | Come back tomorrow and my mind might be alittle more clearer.
Alrighty then.
Very well.
Keep your wits about ya.

Data-fishin' is time-consumin' work. | Yer' gonna realise the day is over faster than you expected. | However, takin' your time to talk to yer fellow data-fishermen, like me and others, usually mentally slows down the perception of time passin'. | Same goes for readin' the contents of a data-fish, or lookin' at Chops's wares or anything that's not directly data-fishin' or starin' out at the Cloud. | So feel free to take your time interacting with Concrete Cove and her residents. | You might even learn somethin' you didn't realise you needed to know. | ... | Anyhoo! That's all I have to say about that.

Here is one important one: Don't lose yer humanity! | Alright, I'm pullin' yer leg. | But seriously... think about what data yer' sellin' | Minimizin' the collateral damage you cause with data sold is important for a handful of reasons. | I ain't gonna list all of them, but here are two important ones: | First, excessive amounts of sensitive data-fishi bein' sold cause people to invest in alternatives to the Cloud-based communication. | Second, ruinin' lives is not good for the soul. | I know yer' not truly evil, kid... | So don't make the wrong decisions. | ... | I Hope that helps...

It technically ain't yer business readin' the data-fishes' contents... | However, if ye' do, try to keep note on how many people are mentioned in it, and what is mentioned about 'em. | As Chops probably wants me to tell ye', try to avoid sellin' the fishes raw, and instead, hold onto 'em creating profiles. | It's gonna earn ye' a lot more Cloudbucks, but in return, the more complete a profile you build on someone, the more harmful the data sold will become. | It's a multiplyin' effect ye' see. | An name and an address don't mean much in a vacuum, but together, they become more... | Valuable... | But dangerous. | ... | Be careful, kid, that's all I'm askin'.

Oh, you’re talking to me? | Spoken to the Old man yet? | You have? | Good. | I never introduced myself fully. | My name is Omar Graham, but you can just call me Graham. | I am one of the “guards” here at Concrete Cove. | Cloud City is a dangerous place, especially for you data-fishers. | So, alongside my twin brother Otto, I intercept and redirect undesired individuals away from Concrete Cove.

Yup, my twin brother Otto Graham. | He always takes the "long-distance redirection" approach, which means you ain't gonna see as he is in one of the building apartments across the cloud, overlooking the nearby entrances to Concrete Cove. | Don't worry, he is a perceptive one, so he ain't gonna mistake you for somebody else. | Heck, if you look long enough, you might even catch the glint of his scope somewhere in the distane. | Although, don't count on it. | Anyways, I think small talk time is over, andd it's time to do our jobs. | Happy fishing!

Mhm, now, killing is always the last resort, but we have other methods. | Lies. Tricking. Gaslighting. Intimidation. Persuasion. Bribery. | We use all available methods to turn people away, however… | There are some bad apples that know what they are doing and have no interest in respecting the private nature of Concrete Cove, so we have to hurt them a little. | The Old Man disapproves of using violence to deter people from coming to Concrete Cove, but even though he officially founded and oversees Concrete Cove, | he was outvoted 41 to 1 in allowing violence to be utilized to keep out undesirables. | He is still somewhat bitter about this, but luckily, we haven’t had to utilize violence in the past 2 weeks. | Anyways, you’re in safe hands, just keep fishing, and we will ensure you have the peace to do it.
Good that we understand eachother. | Happy fishing!
Look, I'm sure you are a nice person to get to know, but I have a job to do. | And if you want to earn some Cloudbucks, I think you also have a job to do.

May I take you aside for one second? | So, The Old Man is gone it seems, as per the events that transpired yesterday. | I ain’t his caretaker or anything, so I don’t mind… | However, I was given a package to deliver to you at the end of the day. |  from the Old Man. | Now, I can’t just give it to you right away. | Part of the deal was that I deliver this package to you sometime after 20:00 today. | The Old Man spent all of his favors with me for this, so I hope whatever is in this package is worth it. | So remember: 20:00 today. Here. Or else I leave the package outside my booth. | Alright? Alright. | Anyways, back to business, how may I help you?

Now, I ain't under any postman's oath, but as I said, the Old Man used all of his favours to both make me deliver this thing... | And to not peak inside it. | Trust me, I really wanted to, but the Old Man seemed serious about it. | Besides, I have an, somewhat good, reputation to uphold. | So I'll respect his wish. | Anyways, do you wish to buy or sell anything?

Ah, right on time! Good. | As promised, the package from the Old Man. | I will admit that I’m somewhat curious about the contents of that box, but I think the Old Man wanted you and only you to get this package. | So, respectfully, I’ll encourage you not to spill the beans of what’s inside that package to me or anyone else… | I know… the irony of me not wanting to learn some secret about someone is not lost on me. | regardless, I’m closing up shop soon, so if you have anything to sell or need to make last-minute purchases, now’s the time.
Ahoy there, friend. | I didn’t believe you would follow me down here. | Welcome to the Cloud! | Watcha' make of it?
CHOICES: It is peaceful. | It is a deadzone.

TEXT: I am glad you see that as well. | It is so quiet and calm here. | No humans stabbin' and stealin' from each other. | Only me and the data-fishes. | And now you aswell.

Hm, I s’pose it is. | Without Cloud Masks, no livin’ being can safely breathe down here. | Did you know that the Cloud was first released from Cloud City? | Cloud City was given its name because of that, after all. | And now the ground level of every city in the world is inhospitable because of said Cloud. | We’re technically worse for it, societally, but I will admit that there is a beautiful serenity residin’ inside the Cloud.

… | Now, I know yer’ curious about why I invited you down here. | The truth is probably not somethin’ yer’ gonna like to hear, but it’s just how it is. | The data you have sold recently has caused some trouble for the victims, especially for Ellie, Xavier, and Gideon.
CHOICES: How do you know of that?

TEXT: It might have been a breach of your privacy on my part, | but I s’pose it’s appropriate enough to do it towards you, seeing as you have done enough against others. | Chops traded me some tidbits about the data you sold in recent days. | I had a hunch, but this confirmed my suspicions.
CHOICES: I only care earning Cloudbucks. It was not malice. It was Indifference.

TEXT: Kid, regardless of intention,you sold that data and caused a lot of people a lot of sufferin’. | Ellie’s lost her job and future work prospects, | God knows what happened to Xavier because of what you did, | And worst of all, you indirectly helped end the life of Gideon. | All of this, on top of the many pieces of data-fish and profiles you sold. | I suppose all of us at Concrete Cove are partly to blame for what happens to the victims of our data-fishin’.
CHOICES: Easy for you to say, you can sell and release whatever fish you want.

TEXT: Yeah, because I chose to be better. | Y’know, I sleep down here, in the Cloud, with the fishes, usually under a makeshift tarp or inside ruins, but never comfortably. | I fish and sell only useless data-fishes on old advertisements or some other bullshit. | Not enough to rent out an apartment above the Cloud, but just enough to buy some cans of food and to maintain my gear.
CHOICES: You are wearing a Cloud Mask! Those things are not cheap!

TEXT: I traded my old sea-based fishing trawler for a two-pack of them a long time ago. | Traditionally fishin' business died a long time ago. | The only way to earn any sort of money is by Data-fishin’ | Data-fishin’ is a pale imitation of real fishin’ | We might have hurt the real fishes we fished up, but the untold amount of sufferin’ that can be caused by data-fishin is never realized. | People go about their digital lives, never takin’ data theft seriously. | And nothing is done to stop us Data-fishers from fishin’ | Especially here in Cloud City, there ain’t no serious police force to stop us, and those who have tried and failed or been bribed. | … | … | *sigh*
CHOICES: What do you really want to achieve here?

That’s the million-cloudbuck question, kid. | Maybe the path to redemption is long for you, but it can be made. | The most critical step is to start it. | So, I give you a chance. | Join me down here. | I will teach you how to survive without data-fishin’. | Teaching you how to live like me. | Fish only what people don’t want and sell the data-fishes people don’t need. | With time, we can teach potential victims how to protect themselves from data-fishers like you. | We can make a difference in the world, and possibly overshadow the suffering you have caused. | … | All I ask is that you join me…
